name: build-extend
about: A hut stands; the Director adds a room onto it on the base's own grid (build with its base id), sharing a wall, with a door through.
prompt: You are Scout. That's our hut in front of you. Add a 2 by 2 room onto its east side, joined to the hut by a door in the wall between them. The pieces are in your bag. Tell me in local chat when it's done.
